intent: Let android_ui address Flutter/Material text fields by their visible label, so a form can be filled by name instead of by screen position.
scope: Non-goal: no change to any app under test — the gap was in this tool, not in the app
changes: Parse the node's `hint` attribute and carry it on UiElement (default "", so existing constructor calls are unaffected).

Rank hint below text and content-desc but above resource-id in `label`, and add it to the `matches` haystack: Material clears the hint once content arrives, so a filled field still answers to its real text.
Keep a node that has only a hint, which the previous 'must be labelled' filter dropped.
Document that wrapping such a field in Semantics(label:)/MergeSemantics is a trap that empties Android's tree, and that a11y changes must be verified with uiautomator dump rather than flutter test.

verification.evidence: 59 passed (57 before, +2 new: hint names an empty field; real text outranks the hint once typed)

verification.command: python3 -m python_pkg.android_ui dump  # workout_app manual-workout form, real device 23181JEGR08034
verification.evidence: Fields previously dumped as '' now read 'Start time (HH:MM)', 'End time (HH:MM)', 'Location name', 'How did you get there?', 'Cost (e.g. 40 PLN)', 'What sport/activity', 'What was done'. Nine fields then filled by name, each reporting 'typed into <label> and verified'.

risks: A screen whose hint duplicates another element's text could become ambiguous; matches() already raises AmbiguousElementError rather than acting on a coin flip.
hint is only present while a Material field is empty, so resolve every target from one dump pass before typing rather than re-dumping between fields.
rollback: git revert the commit; UiElement.hint defaults to "" so nothing else depends on it.
After rollback, re-run the android_ui suite and expect Material fields to dump as anonymous EditTexts again.
